nodes.html: We take a considered approach to selecting accountants for the Your Accountant Match network. Our checks are designed to confirm who they are, understand the services they provide and help ensure each accountant is appropriately matched to their local area. Here is what our selection and ongoing review process includes.
nodes.text: We take a considered approach to selecting accountants for the Your Accountant Match network. Our checks are designed to confirm who they are, understand the services they provide and help ensure each accountant is appropriately matched to their local area. Here is what our selection and ongoing review process includes.

nodes.html: Before an accountant joins our network, we confirm their identity and key business details. This may include checking their legal or trading name, ABN, business location and contact information against appropriate public records. These checks help us establish that we are dealing with a genuine Australian accounting business and that the information supplied to us is consistent and current at the time of onboarding.
nodes.text: Before an accountant joins our network, we confirm their identity and key business details. This may include checking their legal or trading name, ABN, business location and contact information against appropriate public records. These checks help us establish that we are dealing with a genuine Australian accounting business and that the information supplied to us is consistent and current at the time of onboarding.

nodes.html: We check relevant professional registrations according to the services the accountant intends to provide. This may include confirming registration as a tax agent or BAS agent through the Tax Practitioners Board and reviewing other professional credentials where applicable. Because different accounting services require different qualifications and registrations, our checks are tailored to the work each accountant represents they are authorised and equipped to undertake.

nodes.html: Services and Areas of Expertise Established
nodes.text: Services and Areas of Expertise Established

nodes.html: Not every accountant provides the same services or works with the same types of clients. We establish the accountant’s principal areas of service, which may include personal taxation, business accounting, bookkeeping, BAS and GST, payroll, self-managed super funds or business registrations. This information helps us understand the type of assistance they offer and supports a more relevant introduction based on the customer’s selected accounting needs.
nodes.text: Not every accountant provides the same services or works with the same types of clients. We establish the accountant’s principal areas of service, which may include personal taxation, business accounting, bookkeeping, BAS and GST, payroll, self-managed super funds or business registrations. This information helps us understand the type of assistance they offer and supports a more relevant introduction based on the customer’s selected accounting needs.

nodes.html: We confirm the geographical area each accountant intends to service, including the suburbs, postcodes or broader region covered by their Your Accountant Match territory. Depending on the accountant and the customer’s preference, services may be provided in person, remotely or through a combination of both. Confirming the service area helps us connect customers with an accountant who is available to assist people and businesses in their area.

nodes.html: Professional Indemnity Insurance Checked Where Applicable
nodes.text: Professional Indemnity Insurance Checked Where Applicable

nodes.html: Where professional indemnity insurance is applicable to the accountant’s services or registration, we request confirmation of appropriate cover. Professional indemnity insurance can provide protection in connection with claims arising from professional services. Requirements may vary according to the accountant’s registrations, professional memberships and the services they provide. Accountants remain responsible for maintaining any insurance required for their business and professional activities.
nodes.text: Where professional indemnity insurance is applicable to the accountant’s services or registration, we request confirmation of appropriate cover. Professional indemnity insurance can provide protection in connection with claims arising from professional services. Requirements may vary according to the accountant’s registrations, professional memberships and the services they provide. Accountants remain responsible for maintaining any insurance required for their business and professional activities.

nodes.html: Our checking process does not necessarily end when an accountant joins the network. We may periodically ask participating accountants to confirm or update important information, including their contact details, services, registrations, insurance and service area. We may also review publicly available professional information where appropriate. These reviews help us keep our network records current and identify material changes that could affect an accountant’s participation or the services they provide.

nodes.html: A Clear Process for Customer Concerns
nodes.text: A Clear Process for Customer Concerns

nodes.html: If a customer raises a concern about an introduction or their experience with a participating accountant, we provide a clear way for them to contact Your Accountant Match. We record and consider the information provided, seek further details where appropriate and determine whether any action is required concerning the accountant’s participation in our network. Professional service complaints may also need to be directed to the accountant or an appropriate regulatory body.
nodes.text: If a customer raises a concern about an introduction or their experience with a participating accountant, we provide a clear way for them to contact Your Accountant Match. We record and consider the information provided, seek further details where appropriate and determine whether any action is required concerning the accountant’s participation in our network. Professional service complaints may also need to be directed to the accountant or an appropriate regulatory body.

nodes.html: Our selection process is designed to support informed, relevant introductions—not to guarantee a particular result or replace a customer’s own decision-making. Customers are encouraged to discuss their requirements, fees and engagement terms directly with their matched accountant before proceeding. Your Accountant Match introduces one participating accountant based on the customer’s area and requested services, without distributing their details to multiple providers.

nodes.html: A BETTER WAY TO FIND YOUR ACCOUNTANT
nodes.text: A BETTER WAY TO FIND YOUR ACCOUNTANT

nodes.html: Your Accountant Match is a free matching service that connects Australians with accountants from our network, matched to your area and the accounting help you need.
nodes.text: Your Accountant Match is a free matching service that connects Australians with accountants from our network, matched to your area and the accounting help you need.

nodes.html: Our founder created Your Accountant Match because he saw a better way to introduce people to a local accountant than leaving them to choose from a directory listing. He brings more than 19 years of experience working closely with members of the National Tax & Accountants’ Association (NTAA) and accounting professionals across Australia.
